tools.name: option_desk_status
tools.description: Check the Option Desk data mode, source, refresh time, and public licence gate before requesting figures. No live feed or hosted backtest tool exists, even with uploaded history. Do not offer hosted backtests.

tools.name: option_snapshot_schema
tools.description: Return the accepted CSV and JSON option-chain fields, safe repair rules, size limits, data-rights confirmation, and retention policy.

tools.name: option_chain_snapshot
tools.description: Summarize SYNTH or analyze a user-supplied option chain for private analysis. This service never fetches market data.

tools.name: option_positioning
tools.description: Return gamma walls, gamma flip, and max pain from SYNTH or a user-supplied chain. Dealer signs are an assumption, not observed positions.

tools.name: option_plots
tools.description: Render opaque PNG plots in the conversation. The SYNTH sample offers the market plot (dealer gamma exposure, open interest, volume and the smile by strike), the Greek ladder, and the structure comparison. Each is computed from the sample's own engine artifacts; there is no simulation or backtest for

tools.name: option_strategy_plot
tools.description: Show an option-strategy payoff as an opaque PNG in the conversation. Any structure in the engine playbook can be built on the SYNTH sample chain. A market ticker requires user-supplied chain data. Do not start a localhost dashboard.

tools.name: option_report_plots
tools.description: Return the market map, Greek ladder, strategy comparison and up to three requested payoff charts in ONE widget. Prefer this tool for multi-chart reports instead of parallel individual plot calls. Includes strategy_records, Greek units, scenarios and cost assumptions. Use those records for tables; ne

tools.name: option_private_dashboard
tools.description: Create a private interactive dashboard from user-supplied data. The bearer URL and all derived artifacts expire after one hour.

tools.name: option_validate_snapshot
tools.description: Validate and safely normalize a user-supplied option-chain snapshot. Return corrections and a summary. Delete all temporary files before the response.

tools.name: option_import_snapshot
tools.description: Import user-supplied option-chain data into a bearer-private interactive dashboard. Delete the artifacts after one hour.

tools.name: option_plots_from_snapshot
tools.description: Create opaque market and Greek PNG images from a user-supplied snapshot. Stamp source, capture time, expiry, and warnings on every image. Delete temporary files before the response.

tools.name: option_strategy_from_snapshot
tools.description: Build one option structure from a user-supplied chain and return its opaque payoff PNG with permanent source and risk warnings.

tools.name: option_delete_snapshot
tools.description: Delete one short-lived imported dashboard before its automatic one-hour expiry.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "option_private_dashboard" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
